d:
Karwa Chauth ka din hamesha pyaar, traditions aur khoobsurat yaadon se bhara hota hai! Iss vlog mein dekhiye Alyona ki subah-subah Sargi ki taiyaari, hamare pehle Karwa Chauth ki yaadein aur doston ke saath saalon se chali aa rahi special puja.
Taiyaar hone se lekar Karwa Chauth ke geet, puja, family time aur aakhir mein chaand ka intezaar karne tak, poora din raha bahut khaas. Aaiye, hamare saath celebrate kijiye pyaar aur parampara se bhara yeh Karwa Chauth!
Best cooked in Wonderchef Kitchenware.
